plan: Drive: from Village of Nakusp, about 98 km (straight line times 1.3, estimate). Via Hwy 23, Hwy 31, Beaton Armstrong Lake Rd, Fish River Rd.
Park: 50.9186, -117.59503, pull off on Incomappleux River FSR (gravel road). Map links below.
Walk: 90 m E, cross country, no trail mapped. Climb about 0 m, about 5 min at 3 km/h.
Hunt: ducks, Sept, Oct, Nov, Dec (season rows). Set up on the shore with the wind at your back: ducks land into the wind (Tip). Shoot only birds you can retrieve.
Use: 12 gauge, steel 2 to 4 (non toxic shot only), modified or improved cylinder rated for steel, plugged to 3 shells (regs).
Legal: MU (Management Unit) 4-33, Region 4. No baiting in Region 4. Season rows below. Study aid only. The official regulations are the law.
Verify: Candidate, scout it first. Check posted signs. Private land can be unsigned. Data dates: roads 2026-10-16, private land 2026-10-09, closures 2026-10-16.
R4D-duck-drive-0003.popWhy: Less popular (quieter): MU 4-33: about 816 hunter days a year for all big game (2020 to 2024 mean), 0.34 days per square km, bottom third of BC MUs; access: average access. Estimate, about 50% sure (my pick).
